src:
MOV     AH, 39h          ; make TESTDIR
MOV     DX, OFFSET DIR1
INT     21h
MOV     AH, 3Bh          ; and go into it
MOV     DX, OFFSET DIR1
INT     21h
MOV     DX, OFFSET INM1
MOV     AH, 09h
INT     21h
MOV     AH, 3Ah          ; DOS: remove the directory named at DS:DX
MOV     DX, OFFSET SELF1 ; "..\TESTDIR": where we are
INT     21h
CALL    RESULT           ; error 16
MOV     AH, 3Bh          ; up to the parent
MOV     DX, OFFSET UP1
INT     21h
MOV     DX, OFFSET OUTM1
MOV     AH, 09h
INT     21h
MOV     AH, 3Ah
MOV     DX, OFFSET DIR1
INT     21h
CALL    RESULT           ; ok
MOV     DX, OFFSET AGAINM1
MOV     AH, 09h
INT     21h
MOV     AH, 3Ah
MOV     DX, OFFSET DIR1
INT     21h
CALL    RESULT           ; error 3: it is gone

DIR1    DB      "TESTDIR", 0
SELF1   DB      "..\TESTDIR", 0
UP1     DB      "..", 0
INM1    DB      "rmdir while inside it: $"
OUTM1   DB      "rmdir from its parent: $"
AGAINM1 DB      "rmdir once more: $"
RESULT  PROC    NEAR     ; print "ok", or "error" and AX when CF = 1
PUSHF                    ; keeps AX and CF for the caller
PUSH    AX
MOV     DX, OFFSET OKMSG
JNC     RESULT1
MOV     DX, OFFSET ERRMSG
MOV     AH, 09h
INT     21h
POP     AX
PUSH    AX
CALL    PDEC             ; the error code
MOV     DX, OFFSET CRLF
RESULT1:
MOV     AH, 09h
INT     21h
POP     AX
POPF
RET
RESULT  ENDP
OKMSG   DB      "ok", 13, 10, "$"
ERRMSG  DB      "error $"
PDEC    PROC    NEAR     ; print AX in decimal (changes AX BX CX DX)
MOV     BX, 10
XOR     CX, CX           ; digits on the stack
PDEC1:
XOR     DX, DX
DIV     BX               ; AX = AX / 10, DX = the last digit
PUSH    DX
INC     CX
OR      AX, AX
JNZ     PDEC1
PDEC2:
POP     DX               ; the digits come back first to last
ADD     DL, "0"
MOV     AH, 02h
INT     21h
LOOP    PDEC2
RET
PDEC    ENDP
CRLF    DB      13, 10, "$"
